scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @worldfoundry/backend" "npm run dev -w @worldfoundry/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @worldfoundry/frontend && npm run build -w @worldfoundry/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @worldfoundry/backend && npm run typecheck -w @worldfoundry/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @worldfoundry/backend && npm run test -w @worldfoundry/frontend && npm run test:scripts && npm run check:emails
